reviews.text: This is a great pet dental office. Very nice and professional staff. Transparent pricing. We have Italian greyhound’s, which are known for having sever dental issues. We had multiple extractions and cleaning done here. The extractions and cleaning take less than an hour and are well worth it.

They were very attentive to my anxious dog who really needed his teeth cleaned after 9 years! He isn’t able to be put under anesthesia, so this was perfect. They were gentle and very nice to my dog and me. Thank you!

I normally do not leave negative reviews, but my experience at South Coast Pet Dental was upsetting enough that I feel obligated to share it.

I brought both of my senior dogs in for a routine scheduled non-anesthesia dental cleaning, not for a surgical consultation or to be pressured into extensive extractions. Instead, the appointment quickly turned into a conversation about removing the few remaining teeth they still have left.

I understand that dental disease in senior dogs can sometimes require extractions, and I am not against treatment when it is truly necessary. However, these are elderly dogs, and I did not feel comfortable making such a major decision on the spot without discussing it with my regular veterinarian first.

What upset me most was the reaction when I said I wanted a second opinion. The doctor made dismissive comments under his breath implying that I would “go spend thousands at the vet but not here.” It came across as mocking, unprofessional, and unnecessarily confrontational.

There is a respectful and compassionate way to discuss treatment recommendations with pet owners, especially when dealing with senior animals and emotional decisions. Instead of feeling informed and supported, I left feeling pressured and judged.

Seeking a second opinion before approving major extractions on elderly pets is completely reasonable, and I was disappointed by how that was handled here.

These folks provide a wonderful alternative service, as compared to the pricing you will get from your vet for dental care.

I hope any one who's pet needs $3500 in dental cleaning reads this, and now knows there is a more affordable option, as opposed to not getting treatment at all.

In my case for a 15lb min pin (jack the rat) our vet quoted $3500 for a cleaning and $185 per extraction.($4055)

Jacks been here twice now, this time for cleaning, with sedation and 3 extractions(he's 10) all for >$600!.

Jack came out after 30 min wagging his tail, and with sparkling teeth, staff is great and answered all my questions.

We drive from the bay area for this service, while i was getting my dog, another lady said she came from Arizona!

Lastly, one reason we have not gone so regularly, was getting an appointment, they now have more techs, so you dont need to book 6 months in advance any more, i got an appointment with 2 days notice!
Thank you!

Just received the most threatening call from a business I’ve ever experienced in my life. The “Owner” of South Coast Pet Dentals, who refused to identify himself, called and was upset that I requested to reschedule my dogs cleaning appointment. My dog is recovering from a seizure. He yelled at me that rescheduling was gonna cost him $1800 in revenue. It’s was ugly and threatening. He said he would smear me around town and make sure my dogs don’t get service at other groomers. What?! Who threatens that? A real scary dude, with a short temper. Avoid unless you like terrifying business interactions with your dog’s health in the balance.
Thank you.

My friends recommended South Coast Pet Dentals to me, and I’m so grateful they did! I now regularly bring my two Yorkshire Terriers (7 and 9 years old) there. They both have very problematic teeth, so finding the right dental clinic was extremely important for us.

What I really appreciate is that the procedures are done without general anesthesia. That means I don’t have to risk my dogs’ health or pay huge amounts of money for anesthesia. If a tooth needs to be removed, they take care of it right away.

The results last a long time, and most importantly, my dogs do not experience enormous stress. The staff is professional, caring, and clearly experienced. I truly feel that my dogs are in safe hands here. Highly recommend South Coast Pet Dental!

I had an amazing experience here. I have a Yorkie that had so much build up on his teeth. He's so small with baby teeth that never fell out. They were able to pull them out and give him the best cleaning. It was quick and efficient. Im SO HAPPY with the final result. The price was extremely reasonable. I could tell by his behavior that he had a good experience. I will definitely go back every 6 months to keep his cleanings regular.

Please do not Take your pet there !! I know it’s cheap but you’ll regret it later I took my dog there to get some cleaning and some extraction after a moth she died !! You probably think that you’ll save money . Believe me you’ll regret it later after a moth I had to take her to this especially dentist they did a x ray and ct scan they found out that she lost half of her jaw !! She had a really bad infection!! Please if you love your pet DONT take it there !!! I don’t get how the business still open

We have been going here for nearly 15 years now with all our little canine family members. I cannot say enough about the care and cleaning techniques of SCPD. I have a small toy poodle and would never dream of going elsewhere for her dental needs.

Based on the reviews and staff responses, I have lost confidence in this clinic and will not be bringing my dogs here. The clinic's negative and unhelpful response to legitimate concerns is troubling and suggests a lack of professionalism. I believe the clinic's business practices warrant scrutiny and potential investigation.

My dog's teeth look brand new!! The staff was super friendly and my dog came out of the appointment happy and tail wagging. This was her first time getting dental work so I was worried that she would be scared but they did a great job and she was a happy girl at the end. Her breath does not smell anymore and are pearly white. They are also very affordable. We will be repeat clients for sure.

Best best Pet Dentals clinic ever！
I would recommend here to everyone who has pet!
My dog had the teeth cleaning and extraction yesterday, today she is already feeling so well and energetic! Because of the pain of teeth, she was not eating well for the last two weeks, and today she seems completely recovered.

The doctors and staff are very kind, professional, and caring toward the animals. They take the time to explain everything clearly and make sure pets feel comfortable during visits. The best part is that their prices are very reasonable compared to other places, so I feel confident that my pet is getting great care at a fair cost.
Thank you so much. 💕

Do NOT take your dog here.
Staff are incredibly rude and condescending. They tried to charge me more than double my original quote at check out. Every part of my experience was uncomfortable and I walked away in tears.
I signed up for an extra small dog cleaning (5-10.9 lbs) and paid the deposit online. My dog weighed 10.5 lbs at his last vet visit four months prior so that is the weight I used. A staff member came out to the lobby mid cleaning and recommended that he extract two loose teeth. He quoted me $40 per tooth and I consented to this price and service.  After the cleaning, another staff member brought my dog out, placed him on the scale and then returned him to me. The staff member tried to charge me for a small dog cleaning claiming my dog was 11.5 lbs (over $100 more) and $80 per tooth extraction. She  told me they weighed my dog after the cleaning so the quote they gave me mid procedure was incorrect and I would held accountable for the new total. The only reason that the staff member weighed my dog AFTER the procedure was because they were trying to charge me more. I asked to speak with the staff member that gave me the original quote mid procedure to clarify the bill. He was the most rude and unprofessional person I have ever met. He provided me with several different totals, all of which contained hidden fees and add ons that were not discussed. He stated that he would call the police and take me to small claims court if I did not pay the difference from the quote mid cleaning (that he gave) and the final number he came up with after the cleaning (that was incredibly unfair and shady). He took no responsibility for the deceitfulness in pricing and blamed me for not weighing my dog prior to arrival. His goal was to get as much money out of me anyway that he could. I insisted on paying the original quote several times so that I could leave and he refused.  He finally agreed to charge me for the original quote and the $40 per tooth he had consented me for after a 20 minute conversation.
There are so many other great small businesses in San Diego that deserve your support! Please do not support this man. He is a liar and deceitful. He made it very clear that he does not care about animals and really only cares about getting as much money out of you as possible. After reading other reviews, it sounds like this is the standard practice at this business. I am just glad they did not withhold my dog in the back until I paid, like they had done to other customers.

Don’t come here. My dog has passed away now.

they worked on my baby Maggie when she had no jaw. They knew something was wrong and they still worked on her. She was in pain. Taking your dog here will only hurt them physically and mentally.You should instead  sedate or put them under anesthesia so they don’t remember any pain.

We then went to a different dentist and they told us that she actually has no more lower left jaw because of her cancer or infection shes had and they were shocked how this company or place STILL worked on Maggie and how everything is just not professional or done with care. They just want your money

After coming here my Maggie has never looked the same. She looked very drained and traumatized and because she was. They hurt her more.

Please don’t take your babies here. Your dog dosent deserve this and please do more research why it’s better to put them under anesthesia

If I could give a thousand stars, I would, this place is so incredible. I took my 10-year-old Shih Tzu for her first dental cleaning ever. Beforehand, I asked her vet how much it would cost, and they said between $2,900 and $3,900 (I almost fell over backward). However, I couldn't afford that, and I was worried and looking for a good place with a price I could afford. By a miracle, I found South Coast Dental Pet. The staff is very helpful, they answered all my questions, and I felt very at ease. My Shih Tzu only needed a back tooth extracted, and her teeth are sparkling clean. I paid $355.00, and it only took 30 minutes, and she left jumping for joy. She's completely normal and is still doing great here at home. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLACE! Thank you so much for the impeccable service.
Who are you and why did you leave a 1 star review?
$25/booking fee. Absolutely obscene for anyone to charge this. I don’t care how good they are. This is a place that is not dog or human fiscally friendly. And it is non refundable.

Wow- great service and business. My dog was long overdue and I was expecting a hefty bill because of it. The appointment was fast, easy, and smooth and I picked up a happy dog!! They explained how the visit went with me and provided me with a wonderful summary of the visit. I’ll share his chart so you can see an example of what they provide, so transparent. His before and afters would be shocking if I could get a photo!!
I couldn’t recommend this place more.

Harrison and I say thank you South Coast!!

3rd time there and last 2 times they changed the price when I went to pick my dog up and refuse to even let you see your dog until you pay through the app .  (no notice  on fee increase, ample time to make me aware, not due to complications)  Last minute Price increase aside, the more concerning aspect is the withholding of the dog until you pay. Absolutely infuriating, anxiety inducing and pretty sure illegal.
If they want full fee upfront then when you get there they should say hey you booked wrong and also we increased our fees after you booked but here is new fee , payment is required at drop off and if there are complications we’ll call you before proceeding with any extractions etc to confirm additional fee..
The 1st price change they said it was because I booked wrong when in fact there were 2 options shown on my phone, new client or returning, I selected returning ( since I was) but when I went to pick up my dog they said it was outside the timeframe ( I guess 11 months)  to be considered returning and I needed to pay more since it had been a year. That was irritating but ok, it’s more work to clean teeth that haven’t been cleaned in a year and obviously their website options were not showing on my phone accurately…or so I thought.
This last time I wasn’t sure of the date I’d taken him in last but I knew it was around 12/13 months so I selected new client, since last time I wasn’t eligible for “ returning”.  Show up to get my dog get a text the new fee is now $350 not $230. They refuse to let me have my dog until I pay and the tooth cleaner guy is “ busy”. As I wait I notice they have pricing on the wall. It says new clients for a dog my size is now $275 ( not $230) but a returning client with dog my size is $350 ( not sure the old rate but pretty sure it was around $230 for my last visit being not eligible for returning rate )and rates are effective as of 1 day after I booked my appointment. So I have to pay this new elevated rate because you changed prices after I booked?
Again asked for my dog while I wait to discuss with the dental guy about rates and they refused.

1. Why aren’t the price changes discussed at drop off ? Why wait until services rendered and then say oh yea forgot to mention it’s $100 more…
4. Why are there 700 options and prices with specific dates ? It’s not rocket science you are cleaning teeth. Ok dog size , has it been a year or less? What is going on with these weird specific timelines?
My guess, make it as convoluted as possible so you can blame the customer for picking the wrong option .
3. Why is it so much more for a returning customer who visits annually ( ok 11-13 months is annual to me but to them it’s a big $$ difference) as opposed to a dog who has never had their teeth cleaned/ new client?
4. Why is 20 minutes of scraping tarter $350 at all. $17.50 a minute? Literally must have been under 20 minutes ..

No it’s not like buying groceries, you don’t pick out groceries and view the price to find that by the time you check out and insert your card that the prices increased 30% and now your card is locked into place so you have to pay or you don’t get your card back.
Also it’s a living animal you lock up and not a credit card.
You’d think a new client/ never been cleaned before would be the most expensive option but you’d be wrong. Returning customers get the jacked rate.
Outrageous.

Please do better, our dogs are not bargaining chips. You have a person in front who should be fully capable of saying hey welcome back , just letting you know you selected the wrong time bracket the fee will actually be x. Also we increased fees this year and even though you booked prior to our increase since you selected the wrong time bracket you’ll need to pay our new fee. Or you can wait to talk to Aaron but here is your dog in the meantime. But no , it’s hey leave your dog when you come back to get him we’ll let you know the fee we charge and no we can’t give him to you until you pay the new fee.

Stop it!!!!! Just be upfront and do t keep my dog as a bargaining chip

Is a pet owner who loves our animals at first I was a little skeptical this place hands down one of the best places to get your dog's teeth cleaned honest open communication timely service before and after incredible difference I would highly recommend this place to anybody that's looking to get their dogs teeth professionally cleaned

My pet was not at all bothered by her cleaning!
Will use them again!

“I recently took my dog, Petunia, for a dental cleaning, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! Her teeth look fantastic, and I can tell she feels better too. Highly recommend their services for anyone looking to keep their pet’s smile bright and healthy!”

I advise anyone looking at this to read the owner’s responses to negative reviews before even calling. They are seriously concerning. There are other options for pet dental care run by more stable professionals.

This place is a gem! After being quoted $1000+ for dental treatment of my 17 year old small terrier mix girl from the regular veterinarian, WITH anaesthesia (rather not, at her age) AND probable extractions, I decided to try this clinic. …

I’m practically still in shock at how easy the process was. I handed my little girl over & within 30 minutes (maybe less), she comes bounding out of the office with sparkling white teeth! I wish I had taken a before but the after is …
